_doc: One managed skill set. upstream is the Git repository, root_plugin the plugin whose skills are the roots, skills_subdir where they live, plugin_marker the file that marks a plugin directory, dialect the shared needs catalog under dialects/, agents_dir where subagent definitions install, collision_prefix the prefix a root skill takes when an unmanaged skill already has its name, extra_needs the set's own rows in the needs catalog shape, and ports the upstream files a harness replaces as a unit with an adapter under adapters/<harness>/<port>/.

extra_needs.uses: setup-pstack writes a role -> model mapping (with a budget) that every session loads; arena, architect, swarm, interrogate, how, why, reflect, poteto-mode, and the implementation playbooks dispatch each role on its configured model.
extra_needs.question: How can this harness persist a per-role model choice that every session reads, and honor it when dispatching that role? If no single feature does both, combine others (persistent-rules to store it, model-selection to honor it).
extra_needs.fallback: Only when no combination works: every role uses the parent model; setup-pstack is proposed for exclusion.

extra_needs.uses: Triage and wait on Cursor Bugbot PR review comments.
extra_needs.question: Does the repository use Bugbot? It is a GitHub app, independent of the agent harness.
